parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese.

- **en**: English.

Default: **en**

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the zone.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz describe-zone-info --lang en --zone-id df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pvtz DescribeZoneInfo --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --Lang en
